Reference / digest/sha2

digest/sha2#

SHA-2 (FIPS 180-4) over the host provider.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

Sha256("hello world").hex();                   // b94d27b9...
Sha256().state("ab").state([99.byte()]).hex();  // ba7816bf... for "abc"

Description#

SHA-2 (FIPS 180-4) over the host provider. Each object is the digest of an ordered byte history: the empty constructor binds empty input, the @byte constructor binds one chunk, state(bytes) returns a successor over the appended history and leaves this digest, its earlier observations and other branches unchanged. bytes() returns raw bytes (28/32/48/64/32 bytes for Sha224/Sha256/Sha384/Sha512/Sha512_256) and hex() the same as lowercase hex. Text is hashed as UTF-8. Construction creates a host state; there is no I/O.
